flags: DROP CANDIDATE (horse camp, not explicitly separated): the operator markets itself as a horse campground: page title 'Horse Campground | Bay Creek Ranch | Shawnee National Forest', headline 'Horse Camping in Southern Illinois Starts at Bay Creek Ranch Campground', 'Saddle up and hit the trails right from your campsite'. Stalls are mixed in with camping: 'you can rent one of our spacious covered stalls. They are conveniently located close to the campsites'; a review on its home page: 'plenty of horse stalls adjacent to your campsite'; rules: 'Please wash your horses/dogs at the hitching posts or in the gravel'. Nothing describes a separate horse area or a horse-free RV section; the about page only says 'We warmly welcome horse riders, hikers, and RVers'. Under the MDC horse-camp rule this is a drop.

LONG-STAY: 'Permanent and monthly rentals please contact' and rules 'with the exception of permanent campers'. No count of permanent sites; nightly sites are sold online at a posted $30. Test 4 has no count (pass).
